use: OUTCOME_ONLY; never decision-time predictive features; no scores calculated.
definition_of_decision_utc: Nominal public clock printed on original FOMC release, converted using America/New_York.
secondary_target_semantics: First subsequent CHANGE announced strictly after episode cut and within horizon; HOLD if no subsequent change within horizon. This is not first subsequent FOMC meeting/decision, which can hold.
known_change_guard: Filter on decision_utc > episode decision_cut_utc, not effective_date > episode date. A decision already publicly announced before cut is known even if its effective_date is later. Net endpoint uses known post-announcement intended target as baseline if it differs from daily effective series.
exceptions: 2020-03-03 public decision is10:00EST/15:00Z, effective March4; historical Fed table date corrected July10,2024.
2020-03-15 public decision is17:00EDT/21:00Z, effective March16; unscheduled Sunday decision.
2023-05-03 decision18:00Z, effective May4. At a conservative Treasury May4 04:00Z cut, this target hike is already known and cannot be forecast as subsequent.
clock_limitations: Printed release clock establishes nominal original publication time; transport latency and archival byte identity not certified.
